basicInfo.title: CHC43015 – Certificate IV in Ageing Support

instructor.name: Sarah Johnson
instructor.title: Senior Aged Care Specialist
instructor.bio: With over 15 years of experience in aged care, Sarah has trained thousands of students and is passionate about quality care delivery.
credentials: Certificate IV in Training and Assessment

description.short: Comprehensive training for aged care support workers with practical skills and industry experience.
description.full: This qualification reflects the role of support workers who complete specialised tasks and functions in aged services; either in residential, home or community based environments. Workers will take responsibility for their own outputs within defined organisation guidelines and maintain quality service delivery through the development, facilitation and review of individualised service planning and delivery.

learningOutcomes: Provide person-centred support to older people
Work effectively in aged care settings
Work with groups of older people
prerequisites: Empathy and compassion for older people
Basic computer skills for online components

modules.title: Core Aged Care Principles
modules.description: Foundation knowledge for aged care work

lessons.title: Introduction to Aged Care
lessons.description: Understanding the aged care sector and its importance

lessons.title: Person-Centred Care
lessons.description: Principles of individualised care and dignity

requirements.entryRequirements: There are no formal entry requirements for entry to this qualification.
requirements.courseRequirements: A national Police clearance is required before the placement component can be undertaken. Evidence of some vaccinations is also a requirement including but not limited to influenza (flu) vaccination, COVID vaccination prior to the placement component.
requirements.licensingRequirements: No licensing, legislative, regulatory or certification requirements apply to this qualification at the time of publication.

careerInformation.industryRelevance: The aged care sector is experiencing significant growth due to Australia's aging population, creating strong job prospects for qualified workers.

workPlacement.description: Bring your learning to life by applying what you've learned in the classroom to real-world settings. Every qualification at Intercare includes a work placement.
process: Student placement will be organised on behalf of the Student by InterCare Training
The Student will be allocated work placement within a 1-hour radius of the course location (public transport is not taken into consideration within this timing)
Student work placement is non-negotiable and must be completed within a 3 week period Monday to Friday. No weekend work is required
We work closely with our industry partners to make student's work placement as seamless as possible
requirements: Our industry partners require a clean police check for us to place you for work placement. If you have concerns regarding your police check, please raise this before enrolment so we can advise if this may impact your ability to complete the qualification.
benefits: Real-world experience in aged care settings
